title: Model deterministic SRD class spell workflows
description:
Model deterministic class spell workflows that remain unresolved after the ngcj SRD audit.

Problem:
reports/srd-choice-prose-audit.txt reports 10 high-impact unresolved spell-selection records across:
- Bard Spellcasting
- Cleric Spellcasting
- Druid Spellcasting
- Paladin Spellcasting
- Ranger Spellcasting
- Sorcerer Spellcasting
- Warlock Pact Magic
- Warlock Mystic Arcanum
- Wizard Spellbook
- Wizard Spellcasting

Starting choices are partly present, but daily preparation, level-up additions, replacements, spellbook growth, and Mystic Arcanum choices remain DM-readable prose rather than deterministic gameplay data.

Scope:
- Add typed modeling for class spell lists and spell filters.
- Represent prepared spell formulas, including ability modifier and class-level formulas.
- Represent known-spell progression and replacement choices.
- Represent Wizard spellbook starting contents and level-up additions.
- Represent Wizard prepared-spell formula.
- Represent Warlock Pact Magic spell choices/replacements.
- Represent Warlock Mystic Arcanum choices at all applicable levels.
- Replace free-text filters like "the wizard spell list" with stable structured filters.
- Keep original prose/source citations for DM context.

Acceptance criteria:
- reports/srd-choice-prose-audit.txt no longer reports unresolved high-impact spell-selection findings for the listed class features, or remaining findings are explicitly justified known gaps.
- Deterministic character creation can derive level-1 spell choices for all SRD spellcasting classes.
- Deterministic advancement can derive level-up spell additions/replacements where SRD rules allow them.
- Prepared casters expose machine-readable preparation formulas.
- Wizard spellbook contents and growth are represented without prose interpretation.
- Mystic Arcanum choices are represented at 11th, 13th, 15th, and 17th level as applicable.
- npm run typecheck passes.
- npm test passes.
- npm run check passes.
- npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack passes and regenerated pack output is intentional.
